opening.argument: The offer is framed as a conventional card product tied to purchases: viewers are told to earn up to 4% bitcoin back, while the description expressly states that terms apply and that eligibility and approval are required. The reward rate is also tied to assets held on Coinbase, and the card is described as becoming available later, rather than promising an immediate or guaranteed return. The material further states, “Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice,” and presents no request for credentials or payment outside the card product.

citations.quote: The Coinbase One Card is here. Earn up to 4% bitcoin back on every purchase.
Terms apply. Subject to eligibility and approval.
Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice.
